interest.zh-CN: 假设有机会学习并尝试，请按你对活动本身的喜欢程度回答。
interest.en: Imagine you could learn and try the activity. Rate how much you would enjoy doing it.

style.zh-CN: 假设两种做法都能完成工作，请选你更愿意长期采用的方式。
style.en: Assume both approaches work. Choose the one you would prefer to use regularly.

value.zh-CN: 选工作时，下面这项对你有多重要？
value.en: How much would each of these matter to you when choosing work?

context.zh-CN: 按你当前的情况回答。这里的选择不会改变前面的分数。
context.en: Answer for your current situation. These answers do not change your earlier scores.

text.zh-CN: 用手动工具修好一扇关不严的门
text.en: Repair a door that will not close using hand tools

text.zh-CN: 用一组实验比较两种材料的隔热效果
text.en: Run experiments to compare how well two materials insulate

text.zh-CN: 给一段无声短片创作配乐
text.en: Compose music for a silent short film

text.zh-CN: 手把手教初学者完成一项新操作
text.en: Guide a beginner through a new task step by step

text.zh-CN: 向潜在客户说明产品价值并争取签约
text.en: Explain a product’s value to a prospective customer and ask for the sale

text.zh-CN: 核对一批报销单与相应收据是否一致
text.en: Check a batch of expense claims against their receipts

text.zh-CN: 按图纸组装一个可实际使用的展示架
text.en: Assemble a usable display stand from a drawing

text.zh-CN: 分析多个月的用量数据，找出季节变化规律
text.en: Analyze months of usage data to find seasonal patterns

text.zh-CN: 用图片和排版设计一本小册子的视觉风格
text.en: Use imagery and typography to design a booklet’s visual style

text.zh-CN: 为行动不便的人介绍如何使用社区服务
text.en: Show someone with limited mobility how to access community services

text.zh-CN: 与供应商谈判一份更合适的合作条款
text.en: Negotiate better terms with a supplier

text.zh-CN: 按馆藏分类规则为新书编目
text.en: Catalog new books using a library classification scheme

text.zh-CN: 调试一台封装设备，让封口对齐
text.en: Adjust a packaging machine so it seals in the right place

text.zh-CN: 查证不同报道的原始资料，判断哪种解释更有依据
text.en: Check the original sources behind competing reports to see which explanation has better evidence

text.zh-CN: 为故事里的人物写一段原创对话
text.en: Write original dialogue for a character in a story

text.zh-CN: 帮助一位求职者练习怎样回答面试问题
text.en: Help a job seeker practice answering interview questions

text.zh-CN: 向赞助方陈述项目价值并争取支持
text.en: Pitch a project to sponsors and ask for their support

text.zh-CN: 清查库存并更正出入库记录
text.en: Reconcile inventory and correct incoming and outgoing stock records

text.zh-CN: 在户外铺设灌溉管并检查是否漏水
text.en: Lay irrigation pipes outdoors and check them for leaks

text.zh-CN: 用一个小模型检验排队时间受哪些因素影响
text.en: Build a small model to test what affects waiting times

text.zh-CN: 设计一组让观众感到沉浸的展览空间
text.en: Design an exhibition space that draws visitors into the experience

text.zh-CN: 为一组新成员带领一次入门活动
text.en: Lead an introductory session for a group of new members

text.zh-CN: 为一项推广计划确定目标并带领团队执行
text.en: Set a goal for a promotional campaign and lead a team to deliver it

text.zh-CN: 逐项检查一批表格是否缺少必填信息
text.en: Check a batch of forms for missing required information

text.zh-CN: 把原材料加工成符合尺寸要求的零件
text.en: Shape raw material into a part of the required size

text.zh-CN: 设计观察方法，检验某种动物活动范围的假设
text.en: Design an observation method to test an idea about an animal’s range

text.zh-CN: 构思一组用光线讲故事的照片
text.en: Create a series of photographs that tells a story through lighting

text.zh-CN: 听一位遇到困难的人讲经历，陪他梳理所需的帮助
text.en: Listen to someone describe a difficulty and help them identify what support they need

text.zh-CN: 说服有不同优先事项的团队为一个提案投入资源
text.en: Persuade teams with different priorities to commit resources to a proposal

text.zh-CN: 按固定规则为电子档案命名并归档
text.en: Name and file digital records using a set of rules

text.zh-CN: 用攀爬设备检查高处构件的固定情况
text.en: Use climbing equipment to check the fastenings of a structure overhead

text.zh-CN: 追查两个统计结果为何互相矛盾
text.en: Investigate why two statistical results contradict each other

text.zh-CN: 为一场演出设计带有鲜明风格的服装
text.en: Design costumes with a distinctive style for a performance

text.zh-CN: 协助有分歧的双方听清彼此的诉求
text.en: Help two people in a disagreement understand each other’s concerns

text.zh-CN: 为一个新的商业服务寻找合作伙伴并促成试行
text.en: Find partners for a new commercial service and secure a pilot

text.zh-CN: 更新日程表，避免多个预订使用同一时段
text.en: Update a schedule to prevent bookings from overlapping

text.zh-CN: 操作搬运设备，把货物摆放到指定位置
text.en: Operate handling equipment to move goods into position

text.zh-CN: 研究一种工艺在哪些条件下容易出现缺陷
text.en: Investigate the conditions under which a production process develops defects

text.zh-CN: 制作一段用手绘表达抽象概念的动画
text.en: Create a short hand-drawn animation to express an abstract idea

text.zh-CN: 根据学员反馈调整教学方法，帮助他们学会一个难点
text.en: Adapt an exercise based on learner feedback to help them understand a difficult point

text.zh-CN: 为一个公益议题组织倡议并争取决策者采纳
text.en: Organize a campaign for a public cause and persuade decision makers to adopt it

text.zh-CN: 按规定的编码整理一批退货登记
text.en: Sort a batch of return records using the required codes

text.zh-CN: 做同一个项目时，你偏好各自完成分工后再汇合，还是边做边一起协调？
text.en: On the same project, would you prefer to work separately and combine contributions later, or coordinate throughout?

text.zh-CN: 在目标明确时，你偏好按团队指定的方法做，还是自己选择方法？
text.en: With the goal clear, would you prefer to follow the team’s specified method, or choose the method yourself?

text.zh-CN: 一段工作时间里，你偏好专注一项任务，还是在不同任务之间切换？
text.en: In a block of work time, would you prefer focusing on one task, or switching among several?

text.zh-CN: 交付工作时，你偏好由团队同事负责对外交流，还是自己直接和客户或公众沟通？
text.en: When delivering work, would you prefer colleagues to handle external contact, or speak directly with customers or the public yourself?

text.zh-CN: 任务相同而做法可选时，你偏好在固定位置处理，还是在不同位置走动处理？
text.en: When the task is the same but the setup can vary, would you prefer working from one station, or moving among different locations?

text.zh-CN: 动手解决问题时，你偏好先独自处理，还是和搭档随时交流？
text.en: When working through a problem, would you prefer to tackle it on your own first, or talk it through with a partner?

text.zh-CN: 接手例行任务时，你偏好沿用规定的步骤，还是可以调整步骤？
text.en: When taking over a routine task, would you prefer to follow the prescribed steps, or be free to change them?

text.zh-CN: 一上午的工作，你偏好把同类事项集中处理，还是穿插不同类别的事项？
text.en: Over a morning, would you prefer grouping similar tasks together, or alternating between different kinds?

text.zh-CN: 了解使用者需求时，你偏好先看同事整理的资料，还是自己和使用者交谈？
text.en: To learn what users need, would you prefer reviewing material prepared by colleagues, or talking with users yourself?

text.zh-CN: 一天中有多个检查点时，你偏好坐着集中完成，还是走到各处完成？
text.en: With multiple checks in a day, would you prefer doing them centrally while seated, or walking to different points?

text.zh-CN: 改一个共同交付物时，你偏好一起实时编辑，还是分别改完自己的部分？
text.en: When revising a shared deliverable, would you prefer editing together in real time, or revising your own section separately?

text.zh-CN: 交付标准一样时，你偏好自己决定用什么工具，还是大家用同一套工具？
text.en: With identical delivery standards, would you prefer to pick your own tools, or use the same tools as everyone else?

text.zh-CN: 手上有多个事项时，你偏好做完一项再开下一项，还是在几项之间轮流推进？
text.en: With several items to do, would you prefer finishing one before starting another, or alternating between them?

text.zh-CN: 工作需要回应外部反馈时，你偏好直接回复对方，还是在团队内部处理后由别人回复？
text.en: When your work draws external feedback, would you prefer responding directly, or preparing the response for someone else to send?

text.zh-CN: 核对现场信息时，你偏好亲自走一遍，还是坐在工位远程查看？
text.en: When checking information from a site, would you prefer walking through it yourself, or reviewing it remotely from a workstation?

text.zh-CN: 任务需要几个环节配合时，你偏好频繁对齐，还是只在交接时沟通？
text.en: When several steps depend on each other, would you prefer frequent check-ins, or communication at handoffs only?

text.zh-CN: 遇到新问题，你偏好自行决定排查顺序，还是按事先定好的顺序排查？
text.en: On a new problem, would you prefer to decide what to check first yourself, or use a predetermined sequence?

text.zh-CN: 当天的工作量一样时，你偏好交替处理长短任务，还是分别留出整段时间来做？
text.en: With the same daily workload, would you prefer alternating short and long tasks, or assigning each a dedicated block?

text.zh-CN: 交付成果时，你偏好亲自向外部对象说明，还是把说明交给对外负责人？
text.en: When a piece of work is delivered, would you prefer explaining it to external recipients yourself, or handing that over to the person who manages the relationship?

text.zh-CN: 常态工作的一部分，你偏好有机会起身活动，还是能在原位置完成任务？
text.en: As a regular part of work, would you prefer opportunities to get up and move, or being able to complete tasks from one place?

text.zh-CN: 提前一周知道具体上班时间
text.en: Knowing your exact working hours a week ahead

text.zh-CN: 工作期间有时间学习新的方法
text.en: Having time during working hours to learn new methods

text.zh-CN: 每个月的收入相对可预期
text.en: Having reasonably predictable income each month

text.zh-CN: 能知道自己的工作具体帮到了谁
text.en: Knowing exactly who your work helps

text.zh-CN: 知道做到什么程度可以承担更高一级的职责
text.en: Knowing what is required to take on the next level of responsibility

text.zh-CN: 在符合工作要求时，可以选择工作的地点
text.en: Being able to choose where you work when the job allows it

text.zh-CN: 工作结束时间通常能事先确定
text.en: Usually being able to predict when your workday will end

text.zh-CN: 接手新职责时能得到有经验的人指导
text.en: Having an experienced person guide you when you take on new responsibilities

text.zh-CN: 收入主要来自固定薪酬，而不是月底才知道的提成
text.en: Earning mainly fixed pay rather than commissions you cannot estimate until month-end

text.zh-CN: 能看到成果给使用者带来的变化
text.en: Being able to see the difference your work makes for the people who use it

text.zh-CN: 有机会从初级岗位逐步晋升到更高级岗位
text.en: Having a route from a junior role to more senior roles

text.zh-CN: 需要时能换一个地点完成可远程完成的任务
text.en: Being able to complete remote-friendly tasks from a different location when needed

text.zh-CN: 在安排自己的生活前，就能确认周末是否要上班
text.en: Knowing whether you will work the weekend before making personal plans

text.zh-CN: 雇主提供进修或培训资源
text.en: Having an employer that provides courses or training resources

text.zh-CN: 淡旺季的收入差别不大
text.en: Having little variation in earnings between busy and slow seasons

text.zh-CN: 能看到使用者采用了自己交付的成果
text.en: Seeing the intended users adopt something you delivered

text.zh-CN: 能看到组织里有人沿着明确的路径晋升
text.en: Seeing people advance along a clear path in the organization

text.zh-CN: 只有确实需要到场的任务才要求在指定地点完成
text.en: Having to be at a designated place only for tasks that need an in-person presence

text.zh-CN: 临时改动工作时间的情况很少
text.en: Having few last-minute changes to your working hours

text.zh-CN: 能在有人给反馈的情况下练习不熟悉的工作
text.en: Being able to practice unfamiliar work and get feedback on it

text.zh-CN: 在接受一份工作前，能够明确知道其中的固定薪酬
text.en: Knowing how much of your pay is fixed before accepting a job

text.zh-CN: 能说清楚一项工作解决了别人什么实际问题
text.en: Being able to explain the practical problem your work solved for someone

text.zh-CN: 有一条能继续晋升的专业路线，即使不带团队
text.en: Having a professional advancement path even without managing a team

text.zh-CN: 能事先和团队约定哪些任务可以在其他地点完成
text.en: Being able to agree in advance which tasks can be done from another location

text.zh-CN: 你现在最接近哪个阶段？
text.en: Which best describes your current stage?

student.en: Studying or choosing what to study

employed.zh-CN: 已工作，考虑在原领域发展
employed.en: Employed and exploring further in my field

transition.en: Looking for work or considering a career change

text.zh-CN: 你有多少全职工作经验（或相当的累计经验）？
text.en: How much full-time work experience do you have, or the equivalent?

text.zh-CN: 你已完成的最高教育或培训阶段是？
text.en: What is your highest completed level of education or training?

vocational.zh-CN: 职业教育、学徒制或其他专科训练
vocational.en: Vocational training, apprenticeship, or other postsecondary training

text.zh-CN: 这次你最想比较什么？
text.en: What would you most like to compare this time?

first_direction.zh-CN: 第一个专业或工作方向
first_direction.en: A first field of study or work

adjacent_move.zh-CN: 能用上已有经验的方向
adjacent_move.en: Directions that use my existing experience

text.zh-CN: 你现在最多愿意投入多长时间补学入行所需的知识或技能？
text.en: How much time are you willing to spend preparing to enter a different field?

text.zh-CN: 你最想继续用上哪一类经验？
text.en: What kind of experience would you most like to keep using?

none.zh-CN: 没有特别想保留的一类

text.zh-CN: 对于必须定期上夜班的岗位，你目前能接受吗？
text.en: Could you currently take a job with required regular night shifts?

text.zh-CN: 对于必须频繁出差过夜的岗位，你目前能接受吗？
text.en: Could you currently take a job with required frequent overnight travel?
